newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real rises 0.01 pct in calm trading.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real rises 0.01 pct in calm trading.

text.p: Brazil's real rose 0.01 percent to close at 1.0296 to the dollar on the commercial foreign exchange market in calm trading, dealers said.
Earlier today, banks speculated over a possible new drop in the real-dollar mini-band, currently at between 1.0295 and 1.0345 per dollar, and the real hit 1.0304 per dollar.
As the Central Bank failed to meet market expectations, some banks decided to sell dollars and the real recovered some ground, dealers said.
In the interbank foreign exchange floating rate market, the real closed at 1.0351 to the dollar, up 0.01 percent.
In the illegal parallel market, the real rose 0.46 percent to close at 1.090 per greenback.
